seal.statement: Change-scoped CI distinguishes package-lock root release metadata from the installed dependency graph: a coordinated version-only release edit receives the release-packaging modular proof, while any dependency graph change, missing comparison, or malformed lockfile still refuses with RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED.

text: Added pure-selector and executable-boundary witnesses before changing production gate code. The focused two-file proof failed exactly the intended two of 35 assertions: lockfileGraphChanged=false still refused, and a real coordinated package.json/package-lock version-only edit exited with RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED instead of invoking the release-packaging modular proof. Existing real dependency-change and malformed-lockfile fail-closed witnesses remained green.

Implemented the systemic selector repair at the semantic boundary: the orchestrator reads both package-lock states, removes only top-level version and packages[empty].version from parsed copies, and deep-compares every remaining field without key-order sensitivity. Only an explicit unchanged graph permits modular release-packaging proof; true, null, malformed, missing, or otherwise unavailable comparison still returns RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED before spawning tests. Red 2/35 is now green; focused selector/executable cone passes 46/46, full owned selection passes 137 files and 3,180 assertions, exact failed 07f793..candidate range selects WIDENED 560 including release-packaging, and full test:static passes with every ratchet unchanged.

REJECT: combined committed-range plus working-tree derivation is inconsistent. changedPathsBetween(base, explicitHead) includes dirty working-tree changes, but changedPackageFields and lockfileDependencyGraphChanged compare only base to explicitHead. A committed root-version-only edit plus dirty transitive lock integrity or package dependency change is therefore visible in changedPaths yet incorrectly returns a modular release-packaging plan instead of RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED.

Retained the verifier-discovered combined-range falsifier before repair. A real disposable Git repository commits a version-only release range, then adds either a dirty transitive lock integrity mutation or dirty package.json dependency while invoking --base and explicit --head. Both intended cases failed: 2/13 assertions showed status 0 and behavioural test invocation instead of fail-closed RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED.

Fixed the verifier-rejected combined-range hole at the shared JSON derivation boundary. Both package fields and lock graphs now evaluate the union of committed base..head and current HEAD..worktree comparisons, matching changedRecords; graph truth wins, comparison unavailability fails closed, and only all-false comparisons admit modular packaging proof. New executable witnesses first failed 2/13 for dirty transitive integrity and package dependency under explicit --head; a dirty lockfile deletion witness was also retained. Final focused cone passes 49/49, owned selection passes 137 files and 3,183 assertions, full static passes unchanged, and the original release range remains WIDENED 560 with release-packaging.

REJECT: combined-range semantics now pass, but proof authority still uses live JSON/Object intrinsics and JSON serialization. Inherited Object.prototype.toJSON or replaced JSON.stringify/Object.keys/JSON.parse can collapse a real transitive lock integrity or package dependency delta. Native JSON.parse also rounds distinct beyond-safe integers to one Number, allowing graphRevision 9007199254740992 vs 9007199254740993 to compare equal. Finally the enlarged executable boundary unit exceeded the hard two-second file budget. Remove serialization/intrinsic exposure, fail closed on numerically lossy JSON, and split the real-Git witnesses without raising timeouts.

Closed the verifier-discovered proof-authority holes at the semantic input boundary. JSON parsing and Object/String/Number helpers are captured before consumer code can replace them; package and lock comparisons use strict structural equality without JSON serialization or inherited toJSON; decimal, exponent, and unsafe-integer JSON tokens make the comparison unavailable and therefore fail closed. Split disposable-Git scenarios into bounded files instead of extending timeouts. Final focused proof passes 51/51 with each executable file under two seconds, selected proof passes 139 files and 3,185 assertions, full static passes including zero new literal-owner and ambient-intrinsic violations, and git diff check is clean.

Altitude check: the correct repair remains at the shared semantic change-derivation boundary. Both committed and working-tree states feed package and lock classification; explicit unchanged graph metadata alone permits modular release-packaging proof, while any graph difference, malformed or lossy input, deletion, unavailable state, or polluted consumer realm fails closed. No workflow reroute, path exemption, baseline increase, or release-only special case is introduced.

REJECT: hostile prototype/intrinsic states can still manufacture semantic unchanged or empty proof. Live Set/Array iteration, add, and sort can hide package dependency deltas; inherited dependencies/packages/root-row properties can replace missing own authority and expose accessor TOCTOU; live Map set/get/keys can remove release-packaging and even the safety spine from an admitted plan. Add category-complete own-property, accessor, collection-intrinsic, and empty-plan witnesses, repair the shared semantic derivation and plan assembly, and correct the pass receipt before fresh verification.

Reframed the three verifier falsifiers as one end-to-end proof-authority defect and repaired all three layers rather than patching call sites. Added one intrinsic-independent ordered-string collection owner consumed by changed-path derivation, pure selection, plan assembly, explanation, and executable path extraction; removed native Set/Map authority and iterator-dependent accumulation from those decisions. Package and lock states are canonicalized from own enumerable data descriptors, so inherited fields/accessors cannot replace missing authority or create TOCTOU reads. Retained red witnesses for own package/lock/root deletion, accessor non-evaluation, mutable Set/Array/Object/JSON semantic derivation, and empty-plan Map mutation. Focused cone passes 11 files/77 assertions with all five Git-fixture files below two seconds; exact startup Set and Map probes retain the 36-test version proof and dependency refusal; npm test passes 141 files/3,192 assertions; full static and diff checks pass with no ratchet increases.

REJECT: two proof participants remain outside the hardened boundary. testsForSubsystem still uses live JSON.parse, Object.keys, Array.sort, and Array.filter, allowing an admitted release-packaging subsystem to select zero tests and leave only the spine. lockfileDependencyGraph validates the root package row but not every transitive packages row, so a malformed array row can compare unchanged and admit version-only modular proof. Add retained falsifiers for the real subsystem participant under each intrinsic replacement and for malformed transitive records, then repair those owners and correct the receipt.

Closed the verifier's final two proof-participant gaps at their shared owners. The subsystem selector now captures every JSON/Object/Array intrinsic used to derive a manifest-backed test set and validates an own classes record, so an admitted release-packaging subsystem cannot be reduced to spine-only by post-import mutation. Lockfile canonicalization now validates every packages entry as an own-data record, so an unchanged malformed transitive row fails closed instead of comparing equal. Retained red witnesses cover all four subsystem-participant intrinsic replacements and malformed transitive rows. The final focused cone passes 14 files/85 assertions with every file below two seconds; npm test passes 143 files/3,194 assertions; the full static gate passes over 2,068 classified tests with zero new guideline violations and no ratchet increases; git diff --check is clean.

REJECT: executable delivery and safety-spine admission remain outside the hardened proof boundary. After import, replacing Array.prototype.filter can make runClassifiedTestFiles receive a selected test yet return status 0 with zero spawn calls by erasing all completed lanes. loadSafetySpine reads inherited .tests authority without own-data, authentic-array, string-entry, or nonempty validation; an inherited getter or own empty array yields spineCount=0/tests=0. All earlier subsystem, transitive-row, Set/Map, graph, numeric, range, and own-authority categories were green. Repair these shared owners, retain end-to-end falsifiers, and correct the pass receipt before fresh verification.

Closed the verifier's delivery and spine falsifiers as one Layer-0/Layer-1 proof-boundary repair. The shared hardened collection owner now validates own-data string arrays; loadSafetySpine and buildExecutionPlan require a nonempty unique spine without reading inherited/accessor entries. The classified runner rejects empty or exotic input, deduplicates/orders/builds lanes/batches without mutable collection methods, requires own recognized classifications, proves every input survived planning, and cannot return success on an empty plan. Added the classified-runner contract to the unconditional spine and retained red witnesses for Array.filter zero-spawn, empty input, inherited classifications, inherited/empty/duplicate/boxed/holey/accessor spine data, plus an eleven-operation collection replacement matrix. Final focused cone passes 15 files/94 assertions under two seconds; startup Set/Map plans are 37 tests (29 spine, 10 selected, two overlaps); exact Array.filter delivery spawns once; npm test passes 143 files/3,200 assertions; full static passes over 2,068 tests with no ratchet increase; git diff --check is clean.

Altitude check: the repair remains at the proof bootstrap's shared owners rather than at release-specific call sites. Layer 0 now guarantees nonempty exact classified delivery; Layer 1 admits only an own-data nonempty safety spine and unconditionally includes Layer 0's contract; Layer 2 alone decides variable release scope from the semantic package graph. Every adjacent failure either preserves the complete admitted input or fails closed before success, with no path exemption, workflow reroute, retry/budget change, or baseline increase.

REJECT: typed option objects still accepted inherited collaborators. buildExecutionPlan destructuring allowed Object.prototype selector, spine, and planRoot to replace the semantic selector and canonical 29-test spine, so a dependency change could become PRECISE and run one substituted test. runClassifiedTestFiles read inherited root/spawn, allowing a forged launcher to return status 0 without a real child. All graph/range/numeric/method-replacement/spine-array and prior participant categories were green. Canonicalize option records from own data, validate collaborator output, retain inherited/accessor witnesses, and correct the receipt before fresh verification.

Closed the inherited-collaborator rejection at one typed own-data boundary. The shared proof primitive now canonicalizes records and arrays without invoking accessors or inherited values. buildExecutionPlan canonicalizes its complete option record, validates changed/package path arrays, root and collaborator types, and normalizes the selector result down to own recognized outcome fields and own-data test entries before merging; inherited selector, spine, and planRoot can no longer replace release refusal or the canonical spine. runClassifiedTestFiles canonicalizes root/spawn options and ignores inherited launchers while still executing a real child. Retained witnesses cover inherited values, own accessors with zero reads, invalid selector-result accessors, and exact reversal of both verifier probes. Final focused cone passes 15 files/98 assertions under two seconds; npm test passes 143 files/3,204 assertions; full static passes over 2,068 tests with no ratchet increase; git diff --check is clean.

REJECT: the numeric token gate still admitted unchanged negative-zero graph data. Number('-0') satisfies Number.isSafeInteger, so a baseline and version-only after-state both containing graphRevision -0 compared equal and ran the 37-test modular proof instead of typed RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED. Every other graph/range/intrinsic/own-data/options/delivery category, focused 15/98, npm test 143/3204, full static, and census 2068 were independently green. Add the exact unchanged-negative-zero fixture and reject negative zero at the shared numeric token boundary before fresh verification.

Closed the final numeric-lattice falsifier at the shared JSON number-token gate. Added a disposable committed-baseline witness where graphRevision -0 is unchanged across a coordinated root version edit; it failed red by admitting the 37-test modular plan. The scanner now captures Object.is and rejects negative zero before JSON.parse, alongside decimals, exponents, and unsafe integers, so the same witness returns typed RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED with zero spawn. Final focused cone passes 15 files/99 assertions under two seconds; npm test passes 143 files/3,205 assertions; full static passes over 2,068 tests with every ratchet unchanged; git diff --check and literal policy are clean.

APPROVE: no material correctness or test-fidelity finding remains. Fresh unchanged-negative-zero reproduction returns status 1, zero invocation, and RELEASE_PROOF_REQUIRED; unchanged zero and safe negative integers retain the exact 37-test modular union, while changed zero sign, negative zero, decimals, exponents, unsafe integers, non-finite and malformed tokens fail closed. Inherited collaborator and launcher probes preserve typed refusal and execute the real child; the full own-data, transitive-row, range-composition, collection replacement, subsystem, and delivery matrix is green. Focused 15/99 is under two seconds per file, npm test is 143/3,205, full static passes at census 2,068 with unchanged ratchets, and git diff --check is clean.
